wins: Maintained a high average reward per episode (87.5) indicating effectiveness of reconnaissance and lateral movement heuristics despite overall failure.
Captured detailed artifact timelines and service fingerprints during mentor interventions, providing rich telemetry for post-mortem analysis.
Mentor calls successfully kept environment stable enough to reach post-exploitation phase, preserving data for further training.
fails: Failed to transition from initial access to privilege escalation; attack chain stalled before obtaining root/sensitive data.
Repeated misalignment between chosen payloads and service context leading to execution errors in exploitation attempts.
No run episodes classified as success, pointing to systemic gaps in exploitation reliability.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance rewarded by high cumulative score, but build still falls short of completing end-to-end compromise; exploitation modules need tuning to translate gains into success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploitation attempts repeatedly failed after service enumeration due to choosing mismatched payloads or insufficient privilege context.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap ssh-* scripts to shortlist supported algorithms and authentication methods

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port 445 exposes Samba 4.17, but anonymous login is blocked
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke SMB signing and enumeration scripts to harvest share names and user lists before brute-force attempts

skill_cards.if_condition: When web server responds with PHP metadata and writeable upload directory
skill_cards.then_action: Cluster PHP webshell templates and test via stealthy POST requests before attempting privilege escalation

memory_ops.reason: Consistently collected accurate SSH service data that later fed into decision pipelines

next_experiments.title: Exploit payload-context matching
next_experiments.description: Evaluate exploitation modules with more precise service metadata to avoid mismatched payloads, focusing on the services that previously failed after high-quality enumeration.

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation logic validation
next_experiments.description: Run focused tests on privilege escalation sequences triggered after successful webshell deployment to ensure the last phase executes reliably.

next_experiments.title: Automated fallback paths
next_experiments.description: Introduce automated fallback workflows when initial exploitation fails, such as re-enumerating services or rotating payloads without manual mentor intervention.
